description: Chocolate Chip Brookie Recipe 🍪🤎🍫 Full recipe: 1) Melt 115g butter in the microwave and add 120g light brown sugar and 50g granulated sugar, whisk until fully combined.  2) Add 1 medium egg, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp bicarbonate of soda and 1 tsp salt. Whisk together until slightly lighter in colour.  3) Weigh your total mixture and split your mixture in half.  4) To one half, add 75g plain flour, 15g cocoa powder and combine. Then add 100g white chocolate chunks.  5) To the other half, add 90g plan flour and combine. Then add 100g milk chocolate chunks.  6) Construct your brookies as shown in the video.  7) Bake at 175 degrees celcius in a preheated oven, for 10-12 minutes.
